references.text: Abraham and Lot separate, and Lot chooses to settle in Sodom, an area later associated with great evil. This can be seen in connection with Satan's self-destructive nature.
The psalm describes how God protects and rescues the righteous from the wicked, which may reflect the idea that evil will ultimately destroy itself.
The prophecy of Satan's fall from heaven can be viewed as an illustration of internal division and self-destruction within the realms of evil.
Jesus uses a similar argument about a kingdom divided against itself to explain why it is impossible for him to cast out demons by Beelzebub's power.
